| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `getCombatLevel()` | Returns the current player's combat level |
| `getCombatModeIndex()` | Returns the current combat style's mode index (almost always 0-3 inclusive) |
| `getCombatStyle()` | Returns the current combat style |
| `getHealthPercent()` | Gets your players health percentage as an int (0 - 100), based skills. |
| `getSpecialModifier()` | Gets the actual value of the special attack bar |
| `getSpecialPercentage()` | Gets the percentage of special attack bar. |
| `getWildernessLevel()` | Gets the wilderness level that your player is in. |
| `hasPoisonImmunity()` | Checks whether your player is immune to poison. |
| `isAntiFireEnabled()` | Checks antifire potion protection is active |
| `isAutoRetaliateOn()` | Checks whether autoretaliate is on. |
| `isDiseased()` | Checks whether your player is diseased. |
| `isEnvenomed()` | Checks whether your player is envenomed. |
| `isInMultiCombat()` | Checks whether your player is in a multiway combat zone. |
| `isInWild()` | Checks whether your player is in the wilderness. |
| `isPoisoned()` | Checks whether your player is poisoned. |
| `isSpecialActive()` | Checks whether special attack is active. |
| `isSuperAntiFireEnabled()` | Checks if the super antifire potion protection is active |
| `openTab()` | Opens the Combat tab. |
| `setCombatModeIndex(int index)` | Sets the current combat style by index (almost always 0-3 inclusive) |
| `setCombatStyle(CombatStyle combatStyle)` | Sets your active combat style |
| `toggleAutoRetaliate(boolean enable)` | Toggles the autoretaliate option. |
| `toggleSpecialAttack(boolean enable)` | Toggles the special attack option. |
